provisionNotices.repeats_other_provision: Dokar da aka wallafa ta buga kalmomi iri ɗaya a nan kamar sashe na {{repeated}}, ƙarƙashin taken “{{heading}}”. Ba a san ainihin rubutun sashe na {{section}} daga kowace kwafi da ake da ita ba.
provisionNotices.missing_page_secondary_source: Wani ɓangare na wannan fom ɗin ba ya cikin kwafin hukuma da aka duba da aka yi amfani da shi a nan. Kalmomin da suka ɓace sun fito ne daga kwafi biyu na Dokar da aka sake bugawa daban-daban, waɗanda suka yi daidai da juna da kuma sauran ɓangaren kwafin.
provisionNotices.minimum_wage_amended_2024: Dokar National Minimum Wage (Amendment) Act 2024 ta canza wannan sashe. Mafi ƙarancin albashi a ƙaramin sashe na (1) yanzu ₦70,000 ne, ba ₦30,000 ba, kuma lokacin sake dubawa a ƙaramin sashe na (4) yanzu shekara uku ne, ba biyar ba. Kalmomin da ke nan na shekarar 2019 ne.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s17_amended_2024: Dokar Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 ta canza wannan sashe. Karamin sashe na (2) yanzu yana cewa "genuineness". A karamin sashe na (4), keɓewar yanzu tana aiki "except where they are legally verified in Certified True Copies". Kalmomin da aka nuna a nan na shekarar 2015 ne.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s21_amended_2024: Dokar Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 ta canza wannan sashe. Yanzu dole ne a kai rahoton lamari cikin sa'o'i 72 da gano shi, ba kwana 7 da faruwarsa ba, ta hanyar sectoral CERTs ko sectoral Security Operations Centres. Kalmomin da aka nuna a nan na shekarar 2015 ne.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s22_amended_2024: Dokar Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 ta canza wannan sashe. Karamin sashe na (1) yanzu ya shafi mutanen da wata kungiya ta gwamnati ko ta masu zaman kansu ta dauka, ba Financial Institution kadai ba. Kalmomin da aka nuna a nan na shekarar 2015 ne.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s24_amended_2024: Dokar Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 ta canza wannan sashe. Karamin sashe na (1) yanzu ya shafi sakon batsa, ko wanda mai aikawa ya san karya ne, da nufin haifar da rushewar doka da oda ko barazana ga rai. Dalilan da suka gabata kamar bacin rai da zagi sun fita. Kalmomin da aka nuna a nan na shekarar 2015 ne.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s27_amended_2024: Dokar Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 ta canza wannan sashe. Karamin sashe na (2) yanzu ya shafi ma'aikacin kowace kungiya ta gwamnati ko ta masu zaman kansu, ba financial institution kadai ba. Kalmomin da aka nuna a nan na shekarar 2015 ne.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s30_amended_2024: Dokar Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 ta canza wannan sashe. Yanzu ya shafi duk wata hanyar fasahar biyan kudi, ba ATM da Point of Sales kadai ba. Kalmomin da aka nuna a nan na shekarar 2015 ne.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s37_amended_2024: Dokar Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 ta canza wannan sashe. A karkashin karamin sashe na (1)(a), yanzu dole ne abokan ciniki su gabatar da National Identification Number da National Identity Management Commission ta bayar. Kalmomin da aka nuna a nan na shekarar 2015 ne.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s38_amended_2024: Dokar Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 ta canza wannan sashe. An maye gurbin karamin sashe na (1). Dole ne service providers su ajiye su kuma kare traffic data da bayanan masu rajista bisa ga Nigeria Data Protection Act, na shekara biyu. Kalmomin da aka nuna a nan na shekarar 2015 ne.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s41_amended_2024: Dokar Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 ta canza wannan sashe. An maye gurbin sakin layi na (d) zuwa (h) na karamin sashe na (1) da sababbin sakin layi (d) zuwa (j), wadanda suka kara sectoral CERTs da Security Operation Centres. Kalmomin da aka nuna a nan na shekarar 2015 ne.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s44_amended: Dokar Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 ta canza wannan sashe. Ta sake bayyana levy, ta maye gurbin karamin sashe na (6) da sababbin kananan sassa (6) zuwa (8), ta kuma kara tara kan rashin biya. Daga 1 January 2026, sashe na 196(14) na Nigeria Tax Act 2025 ya share kananan sassa (2)(a) da (4) da Second Schedule, wadanda su ne tanadin levy. Kalmomin da aka nuna a nan na shekarar 2015 ne.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s48_amended_2024: Dokar Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 ta canza wannan sashe. Ta share karamin sashe na (4), don haka dokar soke ko rike fasfo na wanda aka yanke wa hukunci ba ta aiki yanzu. Kalmomin da aka nuna a nan na shekarar 2015 ne.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_second_schedule_deleted: Sashe na 196(14) na Nigeria Tax Act 2025 ya share wannan Schedule daga 1 January 2026. Kalmomin da aka nuna a nan na shekarar 2015 ne.
provisionNotices.penal_code_gap_197_212: Sassa na 197 zuwa 212 ba su cikin kwafin wannan Doka guda daya tilo da muke da shi, don haka ba su bayyana a nan ba. Sun shafi sauran Public Nuisance, Lotteries and Gaming Houses, Cruelty to Animals da yawancin Offences relating to Religion.
provisionNotices.penal_code_gap_364_365: Sassa na 364 da 365 ba su cikin kwafin wannan Doka guda daya tilo da muke da shi, don haka ba su bayyana a nan ba. Sun shafi hukuncin forgery da forgery of public seals.
provisionNotices.penal_code_gap_410_477: Sassa na 410 zuwa 477 ba su cikin wannan rubutu. Ya ce an buga su a cikin Penal Code (Northern States) Federal Provisions Act, wanda ba mu da shi.
provisionNotices.penal_code_s384_penalty_lost: Kwafin wannan Doka guda daya tilo da muke da shi ya rasa karshen karamin sashe na (1), don haka hukuncin wannan laifi bai bayyana a nan ba.
